title: Consciousness is due to what a system is, not what it has done

statements.text: Processes may explain how a conscious state arose, but cannot remain independently constitutive once the state is fixed. Consciousness is due not to what a system has done, but to what it is.

sources.quote: Processes may explain how that state arose, but cannot remain independently constitutive once the state is fixed. Consciousness is due not to what a system has done, but what it is.
